summary: The page generally adheres to the RTL mobile layout, but exhibits styling inconsistencies on the OTP input groups.

issues.title: Inconsistent OTP Group Styling
issues.description: The filled OTP slot group has an irregular outer border and padding artifact not present on the empty group.
issues.evidence: The right group of slots containing '4', 'K', '7' displays a thick outer border container, unlike the left group.
issues.suggestion: Normalize border tokens and container styles across all InputOTPGroup elements.
